title: Cheltenham Open Data
description:
Cheltenham Open Data gathers official local data about Cheltenham and Gloucestershire into one free website, including house prices, rents, fuel prices, flood and weather warnings, power cuts, schools, health services and Cheltenham Town FC history.

This archive holds the site and the scripts that fetch, check and update its data from official sources such as the ONS, HM Land Registry and the Met Office. Explore the data at cheltenham-od.uk.
